name: Itou Tsukiko
source:
A full-time homemaker whose husband works in sales for a medical equipment manufacturer. She has long hoped to have a child with the man she loves, but to no avail, so she checks into Toriume Hospital for tests as part of fertility treatment.
Her husband’s work had a strong influence on their choice of hospital. He had been working hard to persuade Toriume Hospital to adopt his company’s products, and he chose it for his wife’s stay in the hope of gaining a foothold there.

An older, affectionate, sweet-natured wife who’s head over heels in love with her husband.
She’s a trusting, sweet-natured woman who’s easily fooled if someone tells her it’s “for her husband.”
She has an ample F-cup bust and a long bob with soft, fluffy hair.

Though they’ve been married for quite some time, she’s still head over heels for her husband, as if they were newlyweds. Her somewhat childish personality is part of the reason.

[Translated from the [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ubai_hospital/index.html]official website[/url]]
